verdict.rationale: While Deel documents a general API and MCP server exposing contracts, people, time-off, and hiring-cost tools (deel-docs-8,9,10,20,23,28), there is no documented tool or endpoint for previewing a payroll run or surfacing anomalies for approval — the MCP tools reference lists only contract/time-off/cost-comparison actions, not payroll-run preview or anomaly detection. Missing evidence: any 'payroll run preview' or 'anomaly review' API/MCP tool, any approval workflow for payroll runs.
